evidence.claim: Flagged online transaction 3506725 for $1,000.03 on card C10434-K1 of customer C10434 was triggered by a legacy risk score of 0.90, but the calibrated fraud model score is very low at 0.019 with a historical fraud rate of 0.006.

Card C10434-K1 has an established history of 33 prior transactions, with region 469 being the card's dominant location (24 transactions) and category R being an established product type (9 transactions), directly matching transaction 3506725.

Card activity on C10434-K1 between 2016-11-22 and 2016-12-05 shows no card testing sequences, fraud patterns, or velocity bursts, containing only regular purchases including transaction 3492086 and transaction 3506725.
Device D000126 is a generic desktop profile (Windows 10 Edge) seen on 208 cards all-time, not linked to any fraud ring (ring_id -1), and was used with no proxy for transaction 3506725.
Card C10434-K1 has one prior closed case CC-0873, which was also triggered by an elevated legacy model score of 0.93 and was cleared as legitimate cardholder activity.
Shared origin analysis for transaction 3506725 indicates no agent fraud cases associated with device D000126, recipient email anonymous.com, or region 469.

case.summary: Transaction 3506725 ($1,000.03, online) on card C10434-K1 was flagged by an uncalibrated legacy risk score of 0.90. The bank's calibrated fraud model scored the transaction at 0.019 with an expected historical fraud rate of only 0.006. Graph analysis confirmed the purchase aligns with the cardholder's established history of 33 prior transactions, matching primary billing region 469 and merchant category R. Furthermore, device D000126 is a common generic profile operating without a proxy and has no ties to fraud rings or past compromise. The alert was determined to be a false alarm, and the transaction is cleared as legitimate.

sar.reason: 3a: fraud is not confirmed or strongly suspected, so no report is required

stop_reason: Investigation concluded pursuant to policy section 6 due to a decisive fraud probability of 0.04 (below the 0.15 threshold) substantiated by multiple independent lines of evidence showing legitimate cardholder spend.
